text: Start: auditing every suite under tests/ for mechanism-only assertions. Hunting the markdown-wheel-routing shape: green suite, broken board.

Classified all 56 suites. The disease is concentrated: 3 suites are 100 percent source-grep with zero outcome assertion (board-save-export-runtime, export-bundling-runtime, board-shift-snap-runtime), plus 20 grep assertions in performance-audit-build. Board Playwright suites are mostly outcome-solid. Now proving the top 3.

PROVED 4. In a sandbox copy: exportCanvas() made a no-op, exportProjectBundle() made a no-op, draw() made a total no-op, and the perf audit CDP cache+CPU-throttle calls deleted. All four suites stayed green. board-shift-snap-runtime passes 12/12 with drawing entirely dead.

PROOF 5, the worst one. Made renderMarkdownLineToHtml return an empty string, so every markdown note on the board renders blank. markdown-caret-offset-mapping exits 0 and prints 0/0 probes landed correctly. Its only assertion is failures.length === 0 with no floor on probes run.
